newsitem.title: USA: U.S. counties report deal with Office Depot.
newsitem.headline: U.S. counties report deal with Office Depot.

text.p: The National Association of Counties on Monday announced a new contract with Office Depot Inc that it said would save county governments around the nation millions of dollars on office supplies.
"Fairfax County, Va., expects to save over $400,000 in office supply costs in its first year by moving into the program," the counties group said in a press statement.
"Los Angeles County will save nearly $1 million," the group said about the new contract with Office Depot.
The counties group said the contract was publicly bid by Los Angeles county, but it allows other public agencies to "piggy back."
Participants in the "Cooperative Purchasing Alliance" would get a 61 percent discount on manufacturers' list prices on brand name office supplies and furniture, said the counties group.

"These lowered costs will enable county governments to drive more tax dollars into local programs and services, which will surely be appreciated by taxpayers in each local county," David Fuente, chairman of Office Depot, said.
